prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions consistently underpredicted gains on winning tests while remaining overoptimistic for non-winning tests.
sign_in hint changes were helpful, winning 3 of 6 tests.
home wait_info changes were helpful, winning 3 of 4 tests.
sign_in reorder changes consistently reduced performance across 2 tests.
choose_path copy, home redesign, adoption redesign, and finish new_flow changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests each.
Evidence remains thin for change types tested only once.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Launch Controls Summary Screen: Add a final controls reference screen before completing onboarding to explain pet desktop interactions. (why: Multiple support tickets report confusion over how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after onboarding.)
1: [home, new_flow] Desktop Pet Preparation Activity Sub-Flow: Add a companion preview interaction step during the waiting phase while rendering completes. (why: Home step has a median time of 201s and mean of 2336s, leading to drop-offs during long render waits.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Account Desktop Pet Security Hint: Add a persistent hint on sign-in clarifying that logging in links desktop pet data safely to account credentials. (why: Support receives 8 emails about missing or reset pets after signing in again, and sign_in hints won 3 of 6 past tests.)
3: [home, wait_info] Desktop Rendering Stage Checklist Display: Display a structured checklist layout on the waiting screen showing generation progress steps. (why: Home wait step takes a long time (mean 2336s) and wait_info changes won 3 of 4 previous tests.)
4: [choose_path, copy] Story Screen Setup Duration Copy: Update the story screen copy to inform users that onboarding takes less than two minutes. (why: Choose path median time is 8s with high mean (514s), so setting clear duration expectations early reduces abandonments.)
5: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Certificate Official Mascot Seal: Add a mascot preview seal component to the adoption certificate screen to encourage finalizing adoption. (why: Adoption conversion drops to 66.0%; adding visual completion reward components boosts motivation.)
6: [finish, notification] Finish Screen Desktop Controls Notification Hint: Enable notification prompt and add a hint on home_intro explaining how to summon and control the pet. (why: 3 support tickets report confusion after onboarding on how to control or interact with the pet.)
7: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Launch Count Timer Display: Add a visual timer component on the waiting screen to clarify active background preparation status. (why: Home conversion is 92.1% but has high mean wait time (2336s); timer display improves wait perception.)

scores.note: Finish stage has high drop-off and support mentions confusion, but adding new screens has poor performance track record and high dev cost.
